chapter.heading: The Obedient Rechabites
chapter.v:
The word
which came to Jeremiah from the Lord in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah, saying, [Matt. 7:1-5; Luke 6:37; Rom. 14:3; [1 Cor. 4:3, 4]]

“Go to
the house of the Rechabites, speak to them, and bring them into the house of the Lord, into one of the chambers, and give them wine to drink.” [Mark 4:24; Luke 6:38]

Then I
took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, his brothers and all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites, [Luke 6:41]

and I
brought them into the house of the Lord, into the chamber of the sons of Hanan the son of Igdaliah, a man of God, which was by the chamber of the princes, above the chamber of Maaseiah the son of Shallum, the keeper of the door.

Then I
set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites bowls full of wine, and cups; and I said to them, “Drink wine.”

But they
said, “We will drink no wine, for Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, commanded us, saying, ‘You shall drink no wine, you nor your sons, forever. [Prov. 9:7, 8; Acts 13:45]

You shall
not build a house, sow seed, plant a vineyard, nor have any of these; but all your days you shall dwell in tents, that you may live many days in the land where you are sojourners.’ [[Matt. 21:22; Mark 11:24]; Luke [John 15:7; James 1:5, 6; 1 John 3:22]]

Thus we
have obeyed the voice of Jonadab the son of Rechab, our father, in all that he charged us, to drink no wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, or our daughters, [Prov. 8:17; Jer.]

nor to
build ourselves houses to dwell in; nor do we have vineyard, field, or seed. [Luke 11:11]

But we
have dwelt in tents, and have obeyed and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us.

But it
came to pass, when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, that we said, ‘Come, let us go to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans and for fear of the army of the Syrians.’ So we dwell at Jerusalem.” [Gen. 6:5; 8:21; Ps. 84:11; Is. 63:7; [Rom. 8:32; James 1:17]; 1 John 3:1]

Then came
the word of the Lord to Jeremiah, saying, [Matt. 22:40; Rom. 13:8; Gal. 5:14; [1 Tim. 1:5]] [Luke 6:31]

“Thus says
the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Go and tell the men of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, “Will you not receive instruction to obey My words?” says the Lord. [Luke 13:24]

“The words
of Jonadab the son of Rechab, which he commanded his sons, not to drink wine, are performed; for to this day they drink none, and obey their father’s commandment. But although I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, you did not obey Me.

I have
also sent to you all My servants the prophets, rising up early and sending them, saying, ‘Turn now everyone from his evil way, amend your doings, and do not go after other gods to serve them; then you will dwell in the land which I have given you and your fathers.’ But you have not inclined your ear, nor obeyed Me.

Surely the
sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have performed the commandment of their father, which he commanded them, but this people has not obeyed Me.” ’ [Matt. 7:20; 12:33; Luke 6:44; James 3:12 o Luke]

“Therefore thus
says the Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Behold, I will bring on Judah and on all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the doom that I have pronounced against them; because I have spoken to them but they have not heard, and I have called to them but they have not answered.’ ” [Jer. 11:19; Matt. 12:33]

And Jeremiah
said to the house of the Rechabites, “Thus says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: ‘Because you have obeyed the commandment of Jonadab your father, and kept all his precepts and done according to all that he commanded you,

therefore thus
says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel: “Jonadab the son of Rechab shall not lack a man to stand before Me forever.” ’ ” [Matt. 3:10; Luke 3:9; [John]
